name: notion-workspace-automation
description: MCP server that analyzes, cleans, and rebuilds Notion workspaces. Built by the creator of measurement-uncertainty.mcpize.run.

tools.name: analyze_workspace
tools.description: Full page tree, DB graph, and relation map

tools.name: rebuild_hierarchy
tools.description: Suggest new page tree based on usage

tools.name: apply_template
tools.description: Drop a template into any page

tools.name: clone_workspace
tools.description: Mirror workspace into another (job change use case)

tools.name: create_dashboard
tools.description: Generate KPI dashboard from any metric DB

tools.name: sync_databases
tools.description: Two-way sync between DBs with field mapping
